reader_post_manifest.strategy: Normalize the meromorphic K-type family by its parity base scalar. Extend the quotient across the common poles, use the cross-parameter recurrence for a two-sided inverse, and prove the G-intertwining identity by continuity. On the imaginary axis the normalized multipliers have modulus one. At nonzero exceptional parameters compare a locally proved simple tail submodule with the unique finite-dimensional irreducible submodule on the opposite side.
